source: Wikipedia 'Dancing with the Stars (American TV series) season 35' (rev 1377959004, 2026-10-02): 16 couples; week 1 = two-night premiere with one elimination per night; weeks 2-3 one elimination each; 11 scored weeks, finale Nov 24, 2026.
note: couplesCompeting = couples dancing (and able to score) in that week. 'actual' weeks come from results; 'projected' weeks are the best case allowed by the 11-week format (one elimination per week, 5-couple finale, as in seasons 33-34). Edit a projected week if ABC announces a double elimination or a different finale size. Max Possible also never assumes more couples than are still alive.

weeks.note: two-night premiere, one couple out each night (double elimination week)
